edges.reason: Caller-controlled msg.sender reaches _transfer and selects the creator/foxfox/peterparker privilege branches.
The caller identity determines redlight[sender], which triggers the require(false) lock.
block.timestamp (now) is a direct input of the keccak256 pseudo-randomness.
The randomness result decides whether peterparker[recipient] is set to true.
The randomly written peterparker flag is consumed by later logic inside _transfer.
_transfer executes require(false) when redlight[sender] is set under thisValue.
_transfer performs the sender balance subtraction.
The subtraction result is written into _balances[sender].
_transfer performs the recipient balance addition.
The addition result is written into _balances[recipient].
transfer() invokes _transfer.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom() invokes _approve to subtract the spent allowance.
approve() delegates to _approve.
_approve conditionally replaces the user-supplied allowance with the hardcoded 3762 value.
The overridden allowance is stored in _allowances[owner][spender].
_approve consumes and clears the whitewalker one-shot gate.
_approve reads and writes peterparker flags for owner/spender.
_transfer propagates the peterparker flag to the recipient.
_transfer writes the foxfox whitelist flag for the recipient.
_transfer sets redlight[sender] to arm the require(false) lock.
_transfer flips the wallstreet creator-branch gate.
_transfer resets the radeon transfer cap for creator transfers.
_transfer sets thisValue to arm the redlight lock path.
onlyOwner Nothing() calls _mint, allowing unbounded privileged issuance.
_mint increases the total supply.
The increased supply is written back to _totalSupply.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
BurnTheMall lets the owner set an arbitrary radeon cap that gates all non-whitelisted transfers.
The assigned cap is stored in radeon.
SetSomeTime resets radeon to the chTx threshold.
CheckMate lets the owner freely rewrite the foxfox whitelist.
CheckMate lets the owner freely rewrite the peterparker flag.
CheckMate lets the owner freely rewrite the redlight lock flag.
CheckMate lets the owner freely rewrite the thisValue lock trigger.
SetBurnAddress reassigns ownership to the pre-seeded fakenews address with no onlyOwner guard.
The backdoor write lands on _owner.
The stored owner is the value compared against _msgSender() in the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner gates CheckMate.
onlyOwner gates BurnTheMall.
onlyOwner gates SetSomeTime.
onlyOwner gates ViewSomeChange.
onlyOwner gates Nothing (mint).
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership.
transferOwnership delegates the privileged write to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership performs the owner reassignment.
The new owner is written into _owner.
The deployer msg.sender becomes creator, gets the initial balance and whitelist flags in the constructor.
The constructor stores msg.sender as creator, the privileged address special-cased in _transfer/_approve.
The constructor pre-funds _balances[msg.sender] with 1800000000000000.
The constructor sets foxfox[msg.sender] = true.
The constructor initialises the radeon transfer cap.
The constructor computes the chTx threshold.
The Ownable constructor chain stores the deployer as _owner.
_msgSender() simply returns msg.sender as the effective caller.
